column_order_policy: Workbook Schema sheet top-to-bottom; each M0 ... M11 range expanded in increasing index order.

fields.name: purl
fields.constraints: Required; unique; npm type; exact version required; at most 2048 characters
fields.origin: npm package name and version
fields.description: Identifies the exact package version selected for this row.

fields.name: package_created_at
fields.official_type: Timestamp (RFC 3339; UTC; exactly three fractional digits)
fields.constraints: Required
fields.origin: npm: time.created
fields.description: Package creation timestamp recorded by npm. Shared across versions of the same package.

fields.name: published_at
fields.official_type: Timestamp (RFC 3339; UTC; exactly three fractional digits)
fields.constraints: Required
fields.origin: npm: time[version]
fields.description: When the exact package version identified by purl was published.

fields.name: unpacked_size
fields.constraints: Optional; value >= 0; unknown values are NULL
fields.origin: npm: versions[version].dist.unpackedSize
fields.description: Total size in bytes of the unpacked files in this version's published tarball.

fields.name: file_count
fields.constraints: Optional; value >= 0; unknown values are NULL
fields.origin: npm: versions[version].dist.fileCount
fields.description: Number of files in this version's published tarball, excluding directories.

fields.name: dependency_count
fields.constraints: Required; value >= 0
fields.origin:
Derived from npm:
count of keys in versions[version].dependencies
fields.description: Number of package names declared in this version's dependencies map.

fields.name: optional_dependency_count
fields.constraints: Required; value >= 0
fields.origin:
Derived from npm:
count of keys in versions[version].optionalDependencies
fields.description: Number of package names declared in this version's optionalDependencies map.

fields.name: peer_dependency_count
fields.constraints: Required; value >= 0
fields.origin:
Derived from npm:
count of keys in versions[version].peerDependencies
fields.description: Number of package names declared in this version's peerDependencies map, including peers marked optional in peerDependenciesMeta.

fields.name: dev_dependency_count
fields.constraints: Required; value >= 0
fields.origin:
Derived from npm:
count of keys in versions[version].devDependencies
fields.description: Number of package names declared in this version's devDependencies map.

fields.name: bundled_dependency_count
fields.constraints: Required; value >= 0
fields.origin: Derived from npm: versions[version].bundle(d)Dependencies
fields.description:
Number of distinct direct dependency names designated for bundling in this version's published tarball. 
This measures the bundling declaration, not the tarball's actual contents.
